purpose: First firmware image containing BOTH software routes into the Adafruit nRF52 bootloader.

toolchain.note: Image contains the TOOLCHAIN ONLY (/root/ncs/toolchains/7795df4459). It has no zephyr/ or nrf/ checkout; /ncs is a host bind-mount of the pinned workspace.

hatch_verification.method: little-endian 128-bit UUID byte-scan of the reassembled UF2 payload, plus nm symbol check and objdump of the actual reset paths in the linked ELF

hatch_1_cable_uf2.machine_code_site: recovery_poll @0x396c6: mov.w r3,#0x40000000 / movs r2,#0x57 / str.w r2,[r3,#0x51c]

config_proof.CONFIG_USB_DEVICE_INITIALIZE_AT_BOOT: absent (=n) - usb_enable() happens ONLY inside recovery_usb_start()

hatch_2_wireless_ble_ota.machine_code_site: enter_ota_bootloader @0x38b84: bl watchdog_feed / movs r2,#0xA8 / str.w r2,[r3,#0x51c] / dsb / SCB->AIRCR=0x05FA0004
hatch_2_wireless_ble_ota.handler_encodings_confirmed: len==1 && buf[0]==0x06 -> immediate; len==2 && buf[0]==0x01 -> notify 0x10, k_sleep flush, then reset

control_parent_candidate.meaning: confirms the gap this build closes; parent had the cable hatch only

audio_contract_regression_check.verdict: unchanged - DFU restoration was purely additive

watchdog.open_decision: 900000 ms is a defensive value chosen because it is unverified whether the installed Adafruit bootloader feeds the watchdog it inherits across a soft reset (the nRF52 WDT cannot be stopped once started). Confirm on hardware before reducing.

main_ordering_fix_verified: objdump of main() shows bl recovery_usb_start is the FIRST call, ahead of bl led_start - a failing LED can no longer take the cable hatch down with it
build_warnings_all_preexisting_environme: Kconfig: SENSOR assigned n but got y (pre-existing app config conflict)
CMake Warning: CONFIG_USB_DEVICE_VID default 0x2FE3 (Zephyr test VID)
CMake Warning: CONFIG_USB_DEVICE_PID default 0x100 (Zephyr test PID)
residual_risks: USB VID/PID are Zephyr test defaults (0x2FE3/0x100). CDC-ACM still enumerates on macOS via the class driver, so the cable hatch is not blocked, but these are not production identifiers.
The legacy DFU control point is unauthenticated (BT_GATT_PERM_WRITE) by design in this bridge image: anyone in radio range can force a bootloader entry (denial of service only).
RAM at 68.19% of 256 KB leaves modest headroom.
Neither hatch has been exercised on hardware. This receipt proves both are present in the image, not that either works on the device.
